title: Section 4 test
titleEn: Section 4 test · Travel and longer stay
intro: Lessons 22 to 30. Three short parts: match words, fill a gap, then finish a conversation. Pass with 70% or higher.

parts.title: Part 3 · Conversation
parts.intro: Pick the line that fits the scene.

questions.question: šetamo
questions.explanation: Šetamo means we walk. You hear it on a town stroll.

questions.question: radim
questions.explanation: Radim means I work or I do.

questions.question: apoteka
questions.explanation: Apoteka is a pharmacy. You go there after the doctor.

questions.question: šaljem
questions.explanation: Šaljem means I send. Useful when you write a letter or a postcard.

questions.question: Šta _____?
questions.explanation: Šta radiš? asks what you are doing or what you do for work.

questions.question: Moraš platiti _____.
questions.explanation: Moraš platiti kiriju means you must pay the rent.

questions.question: Volim Mostar _____ učim bosanski.
questions.explanation: I links two facts. Ali would mean but.

questions.question: Rijeka _____ je hladna.
questions.explanation: The Neretva is the river under Stari Most in Mostar.

questions.question: Emir: Šta radiš? Market seller: _____.
questions.explanation: Šta radiš? about a job. Prodajem voće na pijaci means I sell fruit at the market.

questions.question: Doctor: Šta je problem? Ana: _____.
questions.explanation: Boli me glava means my head hurts. That is a clinic complaint.

questions.question: Landlord: Izvoli. Ovo je kuhinja. Ana: _____.
questions.explanation: After a flat tour, Koliko je kirija? asks how much the rent is.

questions.question: Amira: Živjeli! Ana: _____.
questions.explanation: Živjeli is a toast. You toast back, then thank her for the cake.
